facts.fact: 她的目的地=南方死国 Tolanaa——唯一军队不敢跟的地方（「绝不南下」铁律被她自己打破）
facts.anchor: There was only one place she could go where she was sure the Arelian Army would not follow: the Dead Kingdom of Tolanaa.

facts.fact: Felix 早已看穿她的计划；七岁之约「你去哪我去哪」，他强行同行
facts.anchor: Well, tough shit. Where you go, I go.

facts.fact: Arelia 与边境交界处现出传送门（黑烟闪电），Arelian 大军成列开进
facts.anchor: Straddling the line between where Arelia ended and the Borderlands began was a portal.

facts.fact: Kenton 以土系魔法多年布好地道网，全村约百人半数入地窖躲藏
facts.anchor: he’d used his magic to slowly create a network of tunnels over time

facts.fact: Cezar 视力可穿透万物望及极远（守警报器），因在 Roylan 偷窃被抓被割舌，不言不语
facts.anchor: he had his tongue cut out as punishment for being caught stealing in Roylan

facts.fact: 龙经 soul-link 给她慰藉与力量：「龙不会恐惧，龙制造恐惧」
facts.anchor: Dragons didn’t feel fear; they invoked it

facts.fact: 她借龙之视瞬移千里看见蓝黑巨龙；Felix 惊见她双眼变黑金色（继承守护兽之力实锤）
facts.anchor: They turned black and gold. Like your dragon’s.

facts.fact: 来者是 Crowned Prince 与其龙 Tydus（One of the Three、吐冰龙）；劝降被拒后他令全军万剑浮空齐指她
facts.anchor: The swords shifted, turning slowly until the tips of the blades were all pointing directly at her.
